2123231374031429660.en_summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella on why the company offered buyouts to around 60,000 employees: The buyouts were meant to give employees a sense of agency in making their own career choices. Microsoft isn't treating software engineers as obsolete. Software engineering will thrive, but the way teams are organized and the work engineers do will change significantly with AI. Employees will increasingly become managers of AI agents and systems. One Microsoft team of just 11 developers building Cowork now builds a software factory that builds the product. As a 51-year-old incumbent, Microsoft isn't an AI-first company. The transition to AI-driven workflows will take longer than many expect.
2123231374031429660.zh_summary: 微軟CEO Satya Nadella 關於公司向約6萬名員工提供買斷的原因：買斷是為了給員工在做出自己職業選擇時的代理感。微軟並未將軟件工程師視為過時。軟件工程將蓬勃發展，但團隊組織方式和工程師工作將隨著AI顯著改變。員工將越來越多地成為AI代理和系統的管理者。一個僅有11名開發者的微軟團隊現在構建「構建產品的軟件工廠」。作為51歲的現任者，微軟不是AI優先公司。向AI驅動工作流的轉變將比許多人預期的更長。
